lines.text: You remember the question on the way home.
This time, bring it with you: a doctor visit checklist, a free prep sheet, and room for the answers.

eyebrow.text: Only have five minutes? Start here

items.text: Write the one concern you most need answered.
List what you take now: medicines, over-the-counter products, vitamins and supplements.
Note allergies and what reaction you had.

eyebrow.text: What should I bring to a doctor's appointment?

items.text: Your questions, with the most important marked.
Your current medicine and supplement list, including doses and frequency, plus allergies and reactions.
Relevant records or results the clinic does not already have.
Photo ID, insurance details, referral or authorization if required.
A support person if you want one and the clinic allows it.

line.text: A Visit page for that person: your questions with a box to tick each, what is taken now, recent symptoms, and room for notes.
